magic.summary: Robes of disguise are finely-woven grey linen robes with dark silver metallic threads woven throughout in hypnotic spirals.

magic.name: Robes of Splendour
magic.summary: Robes of splendour are expensive, finely-woven silk robes with metallic threads woven throughout in ornamental patterns.

magic.name: Thornweave Hide
magic.summary: A Thornweave Hide appears to be a bearskin pelt with fine owl feather trim and a clasp made from a bright golden-green gem.

effects.text: Melee attackers who hit you take piercing damage equal to twice its rarity bonus

magic.name: Aetheric Blade
magic.summary: An aetheric blade appears to be a finely crafted silver dagger.

effects.text: Bypasses armor

magic.name: Cannon
magic.summary: A cannon is a siege weapon similar to a giant firearm, which typically uses an alchemical reaction to propel an iron ball at extreme velocities.

magic.name: Earthbreaker
magic.summary: An earthbreaker is an oversized bludgeon enchanted with elemental Earth energy, adding +1d6 per rarity level to its blunt damage whenever a melee attack with it hits.

effects.text: Its target's space becomes difficult terrain

magic.name: Firearm
magic.summary: Firearms are ranged crossbow-class weapons which use alchemical charges to fire small pellets of iron or lead at extreme velocities.

magic.name: Flametongue
magic.summary: A flametongue is a longsword or greatsword enchanted with elemental Fire energy.

effects.text: Can parry cold attacks

magic.name: Flying Blade
magic.summary: A flying blade is a dagger, chakram, or other light throwing weapon enchanted with elemental Air energy.

effects.text: Returns to your hand each round

magic.name: Frostbrand
magic.summary: A frostbrand is a longsword or greatsword enchanted with elemental Water energy.

effects.text: Can parry fire attacks

magic.name: Keen Blade
magic.summary: A keen blade is a magically sharpened and balanced edged weapon, engraved with runes and sigils along the blade and pommel.

effects.text: Deals 1d6 per rarity level whatever your Str; any 6 is a critical hit

magic.name: Luckcatcher
magic.summary: A luckcatcher is a dagger with a cage in the pommel fashioned from cold-wrought iron and silver filigree, and silver runes along the blade's edge.

magic.name: Moonblade
magic.summary: A moonblade is a blade or axe fashioned from cold-wrought iron and silver filigree, with silver runes along the blade's edge.

magic.name: Relic Weapon
magic.summary: Each relic weapon is unique, being the weapon used in life by a martyred saint.

effects.text: Its extra damage is maximized against unholy creatures
Only while you keep to its saint's convictions

magic.name: Sparkwhip
magic.summary: A sparkwhip is a silvery chain whip enchanted with elemental Air energy.

magic.name: Sunlance
magic.summary: A sunlance is a polearm enchanted with Elemental Flame energy, which adds two bonus dice of radiant damage whenever a melee attack with it hits.

effects.text: Fires a 4d6 radiant beam (25 paces), 3 charges

magic.name: Thunderhammer
magic.summary: A thunderhammer is a bludgeon enhanced with elemental thunder energy.

magic.name: Venom Scythe
magic.summary: A venom scythe is a glaive enchanted with elemental Wood energy.

effects.text: Target saves vs. Doom or takes ongoing poison damage

magic.name: Windbow
magic.summary: A windbow is a shortbow, longbow or greatbow enchanted with elemental Air and Wood energy.

magic.name: Amulet of Dedication
magic.summary: Amulets of dedication are small worn pendants that may be affixed to a necklace, earring or similar position.

effects.vs: being beguiled or panicked, or psychic harm

magic.name: Amulets of Friendship
magic.summary: Amulets of friendship are paired lockets, one silver and one gold.

magic.name: Amulet of Protection
magic.summary: Amulets of protection are small worn pendants that may be affixed to a necklace, earring or similar position.

magic.name: Amulet of Water Breathing
magic.summary: Amulets of water breathing are small worn chokers that clasp onto the neck.

magic.name: Cloak of Invisibility
magic.summary: A cloak of invisibility appears to be a finely made silk cloak with a cloudy quartz clasp, and thin silver-threaded runes woven along its inner lining.

magic.name: Cloak of Shadows
magic.summary: A cloak of shadows appears to be a finely made dark grey silk cloak with an obsidian clasp, and thin silver-threaded runes woven along its inner lining.

effects.vs: to hide or pass unseen, out of bright light

magic.name: Foreigner's Amulet
magic.summary: A foreigner's amulet appears to be a silver choker with an inlaid pearl at the throat.

magic.name: Gull-Wing Cloak
magic.summary: A gull-wing cloak appears to be a light bluish-grey satin cloak with a ruffle of white and grey feathers woven into the shoulders and collar.

magic.name: Iron-Will Amulet
magic.summary: An iron-will amulet appears to be a cloudy translucent stone set in an iron cage.

effects.vs: effects on your thoughts, emotions or behavior

magic.name: Magic Pendant
magic.summary: A magic pendant appears to be a precious gemstone set into a gold and silver backing, on a gold and silver chain.

magic.name: Pendant of Recall
magic.summary: A Pendant of Recall appears to be a clear gemstone pendant in a silver wire cage, set on a silver chain.

magic.name: Soulcage Amulet
magic.summary: A Soulcage Amulet appears to be a dark, nearly black gemstone pendant in a silver wire cage, set on a silver chain.

magic.name: Wild Shape Talisman
magic.summary: Druids can perform a primal ritual to craft wild shape talismans, which can be used to transform into natural animals or fey beasts.

magic.name: Bag of Holding
magic.summary: A bag of holding appears to be a fine leather pouch from the outside, roughly twelve inches wide, three inches thick and six inches deep.

magic.name: Belt of Feral Might
magic.summary: A belt of feral might adds its rarity bonus to the wearer's Strength and Constitution while worn, adjusting their melee damage, hit points, attack and saving throws, and raw ability checks.

magic.name: Quiver of Elemental Bolts
magic.summary: A quiver of elemental bolts looks like a finely crafted arrow or crossbow quiver from the outside, holding up to a dozen arrows or two dozen crossbow bolts.

effects.text: Arrows or bolts left in it overnight deal +1d6 elemental damage per rarity level

magic.name: Boots of Stability
magic.summary: Boots of stability appear to be a pair of fine leather boots from the outside.

effects.text: Difficult terrain costs no extra movement

magic.name: Boots of Swiftness
magic.summary: Boots of Swiftness appear to be a pair of fine leather boots from the outside.

effects.text: Move each round as if you had dashed

magic.name: Boots of Traceless Passage
magic.summary: Boots of traceless passage appear to be a pair of fine leather boots from the outside.

magic.name: Grip Boots
magic.summary: Grip boots appear to be a pair of lizard-skin boots with ridged soles.

magic.name: Golem Prosthesis (leg)
magic.summary: A golem prosthesis is an artificial leg, designed to replace a maimed or amputated limb.

magic.name: Seven-League Boots
magic.summary: Seven-league boots appear to be a pair of fine leather boots from the outside.

magic.name: Crown of Command
magic.summary: A Crown of Command appears to be a finely made golden crown with a polished red gem.

magic.name: Darkvision Goggles
magic.summary: Darkvision goggles appear to be finely made gold spectacles with faintly glowing lenses.

magic.name: Diadem of Splendour
magic.summary: A diadem of splendour appears to be a finely made silver crown with a polished green gem.

magic.name: Golem Eye
magic.summary: A golem eye is an artificial sensor, designed to replace a maimed or missing eye.

magic.name: Puppeteer's Crowns
magic.summary: Puppeteer's crowns appear to be a pair of finely made royal circlets, one silver and one gold, each inlaid with opal and mother-of-pearl.

magic.name: Radiant Diadem
magic.summary: A radiant diadem appears to be a thin silver circlet with a highly polished silver disc at the forehead, upon which is mounted a flat, clear stone.

magic.name: Spectacles of Arcane Sight
magic.summary: Spectacles of arcane sight appear to be finely made silver spectacles with faintly darkened lenses.

magic.name: Spectacles of Distant Vision
magic.summary: Spectacles of distant vision appear to be finely made gold spectacles with faintly glowing lenses, and a clear gemstone affixed between them.

magic.name: Spectacles of True Seeing
magic.summary: Spectacles of true seeing appear to be finely made silver spectacles with a slight opalescent sheen to the lenses.

magic.name: Stone of Aioun
magic.summary: An aioun stone is a legendary Atlantean aether pearl the size of a pea, woven with almost imperceptibly thin feysilver circuitry.

magic.name: Aetheric Glove
magic.summary: An aetheric glove resembles an expensive silk or leather glove with arcane runes and sigils stitched into it in metallic threads.

magic.name: Golem Prosthesis (arm)
magic.summary: A golem prosthesis is an artificial arm, designed to replace a maimed or amputated limb.

effects.text: Can parry melee attacks

magic.name: Grip Gloves
magic.summary: Grip gloves appear to be a pair of lizard-skin gloves with ridged palms.

magic.name: Rings of Companionship
magic.summary: Rings of Companionship are paired rings, one silver and one gold.

magic.name: Ring of Disguise
magic.summary: A ring of disguise appears to be a finely made silver ring with a polished opal gem.

magic.name: Ring of Elemental Power
magic.summary: A ring of elemental power appears to be a finely made gold or silver ring with a large, brightly colored gemstone.

magic.name: Ring of Guidance
magic.summary: A ring of guidance appears to be a heavy gold ring with a polished dark gem.

magic.name: Ring of Protection
magic.summary: A ring of protection appears to be a finely made silver ring with a polished clear gem.

magic.name: Ring of Regeneration
magic.summary: A ring of regeneration appears to be a finely made gold ring with a polished jade gem.

effects.text: Regain 1 hp at the end of each combat round

magic.name: Ring of Warding
magic.summary: A ring of warding appears to be a finely made gold and silver ring with a diamond gem.

magic.name: Dragon Pearl
magic.summary: A dragon pearl is a sphere of flawless elemental or aetheric materia, called such because the first dragon pearls taken from the skull of recently slain dragons.

magic.name: Aether Pearl
magic.summary: An aether pearl is identical to a dragon pearl, except that it empowers aetheric arcane spells instead of elemental magics.

magic.name: Dream Pearl
magic.summary: A dream pearl is identical to a dragon or aether pearl, except that it empowers psychic arcane spells and fey glamours, instead of elemental magics.

magic.name: Clockwork Servitor
magic.summary: A clockwork servitor is a golem automaton from the height of the Old Empire.

magic.name: Enchanted Crockery
magic.summary: Enchanted crockery appears to be a set of gold-inlaid copper cookware, kitchen knives, a small cutting board, various utensils and bowls, and various herb and spice bottles.

magic.name: Flying Carpet
magic.summary: Often imported from the Sultanate, a flying carpet is an ornate 3' x 5' rug that can be commanded to levitate with a word.

magic.name: Folding Carriage
magic.summary: A folding carriage is a variant of the bag of holding enchantment built into an ornate covered wagon that folds down into an intricate wooden tile the size of a large human's palm.

magic.name: Healer's Staff
magic.summary: A healer's staff appears to be a 6-foot long wooden quarterstaff with a crook at the end.

effects.vs: when healing, while held as a focus

magic.name: Holy Relic
magic.summary: Each holy relic weapon is unique, being the holy symbol used in life by a martyred saint.

magic.name: Lantern of Revealing
magic.summary: A lantern of revealing appears to be a dark brass lantern with a carved white gemstone holding the oil wick, and another golden gemstone inset into the front screen.

magic.name: Magic Wand
magic.summary: A magic wand is a stick of carved and polished wood with metal-inlaid runes carved along its body and a dragon pearl affixed to one end.

magic.name: Magic Staff
magic.summary: A magic staff is identical to a magic wand, except that it is embedded in a longer stick of wood.

magic.name: Magnificent Mansion
magic.summary: A magnificent mansion is another variant of the bag of holding enchantment designed for storage volume rather than portability.

magic.name: Mapmaker's Kit
magic.summary: A mapmaker's kit appears to be a wooden tablet nine inches wide, twelve inches long, and a quarter inch thick, attached to a fine cloth pouch by its drawstring.

magic.name: Mirror of Distant Visions
magic.summary: A mirror of distant visions appears to be a bluish-silver oval mirror with a clear gem inset below it.

magic.name: Ornithoptoculus
magic.summary: An ornithoptoculus is a small silver-and-gold sphere the size of a ripe plum, covered in ornately carved grooves and whorls.

magic.name: Portable Hole
magic.summary: A portable hole appears to be a four-foot-diameter circle of black cloth with a drawstring.

magic.name: Replenishing Decanter
magic.summary: A replenishing decanter appears to be an expensive quartz flask with a silver handle and lid and an inset aquamarine gem, filled with clear fluid.

magic.name: Revealing Mirror
magic.summary: A revealing mirror is a large silver wall-mirror with an inset gem on its frame.

magic.name: Teleportation Circle
magic.summary: A teleportation circle is a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground inscribed with modular sigils that can link its location to any other teleportation circle, anywhere in the universe.

magic.name: Wishing Stones
magic.summary: The wishing stones are a collection of seven enormous dragon pearls, one of each element.
